searchText: I suspect that is going to end up being me, since I have been on an ISO-8601 crusade for the better part of a decade: <https://github.com/ethereum/eth1.0-specs/pull/259> Like most of my crusades, I'm losing. If it were only up to me, I would mark Erigon as stable yesterday 🤷‍♂️ OpenEthereum has always been stable despite all the breaking bugs and unstable warp sync various releases had Usually we consider a client as ready when the specific version is included in the hard fork announcement post on the Ethereum blog Fair > ISO 8601 tackles this uncertainty by setting out an internationally agreed way to represent dates: > > YYYY-MM-DD https://www.iso.org/iso-8601-date-and-time-format.html Our changelog uses that. "v1.4.0.1 2021-07-13" being american, you, by association, don't care much for sane date formatting at all 😛 Could we please move discussions about date formats to the off-topic channel? https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/releases/tag/1.10.77 Merged. Hope this is the end of it 😅 The mainnet block has been added 4 days ago, after the last release. We will do release tomorrow and that will have it in
